assets.name: lecture_08_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: The settled board state clearly shows Alice's reduced density matrix and the sum over Bob's label.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The frame pairs the ket-side unitary action with the Hermitian-conjugate action on bra coefficients.
assets.caption_hint: Local unitary action on ket and bra indices

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: The full U-dagger-U contraction is visible during the decisive step of the locality proof.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: The simulator apparatus, measurement control, computer, and two stored amplitudes are visible together.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: The central computer and the four amplitudes of the joint two-spin state are legible before the wires are conceptually cut.
assets.caption_hint: Central simulator for an entangled pair

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: The board cleanly defines the position wave function as a basis projection.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: The narrow spike, epsilon width, reciprocal height, and fixed-area construction are all visible.
assets.caption_hint: Dirac delta as a unit-area spike

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: The continuous expansion and delta-function consistency check are visible in a settled board frame.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: The discrete bra-ket expansion is visible and supports the transition from finite sums to the continuous inner product.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: Both orders of the position-operator matrix element are visible during the Hermiticity check.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: The integration-by-parts relation and its minus sign are legible at the conclusion that differentiation is anti-Hermitian.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: The two forms of the momentum expectation value are visible when their complex-conjugate relation is stated.
assets.caption_hint: Reality of the momentum expectation value

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_13.png
assets.rationale: The board shows the operator that annihilates every wave function and the resulting canonical commutator.
